mechanics_summary: 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate. The user becomes invisible for about one second and can move during the invisible phase before reappearing and firing a long, XL-range beam. Current dedicated documentation reports 23 hits and about 40% total damage; exact movement window and patch-independent damage scaling remain unresolved.
